claim: The approved brand name is Mineral Rights Xchange (MRX), and the canonical public domain is https://mineralrightsxchange.com.
MRX provides free, no-pressure mineral-rights education, secure owner intake, and a directional Senior Underwriter review for U.S. mineral and royalty owners.

A directional assessment uses available public records, production data, owner-provided documents, and stated assumptions; it is not a certified appraisal or legal, tax, title, accounting, engineering, or investment advice.
MRX may earn revenue by purchasing mineral interests as the disclosed buyer; terms and that relationship are provided in writing before an agreement.

MRX must not be presented as a neutral marketplace, broker, agent, commission-only intermediary, certified appraiser, or professional adviser unless future evidence is separately reviewed and approved.
MRX Editorial Team is the approved organizational content author; a named underwriter or an AI-guide persona must not be presented as the author, a human, or a licensed professional.

ProfessionalService is the approved service-type classification; nationwide online coverage does not establish LocalBusiness or Google Business Profile eligibility, a storefront, a travel service area, or a licensed local presence.
The canonical MRX icon-system colors are navy #0B1F3A and gold #C8A24A.
MRX marketing must not use unsupported statistics, payout figures, customer counts, years-in-business, trusted-by language, credentials, results, reviews, testimonials, or social proof.

Each new or materially revised article must use a unique hero image containing the exact final article title and reuse that asset for hero, Open Graph, Twitter, and CMS featured/share identity, while also providing a separate verified in-body image.
Search, indexing, AI visibility, citation, media pickup, and model-training access must be reported as dated observations with denominators and evidence, never as guaranteed outcomes.
